description: Constructed (surveillance mammogram of the left breast after a right mastectomy). A normal statement about the right breast contradicts its surgical absence (matched); one sentence on two calcified fibroadenomas covers both gt fibroadenomas (1:N); an oval mass and a focal asymmetry at the same site are two readings of one finding (matched); 'no left axillary lymphadenopathy' denies the enlarged node; 'no suspicious calcifications' is a qualified negative and does not deny dystrophic calcifications (both left unmatched).

user.indication: History of right mastectomy for breast cancer. Surveillance.

pred_findings.text: No suspicious findings in the right breast.
Two degenerating fibroadenomas with coarse popcorn-like calcifications in the left breast at 2 and 4 o'clock.
1.2 cm oval circumscribed mass in the left breast at 9 o'clock, middle depth, BI-RADS 3.
No suspicious calcifications in the left breast.

gt_findings.text: Degenerating fibroadenoma with coarse popcorn-like calcifications in the left breast at 2 o'clock.
Degenerating fibroadenoma with coarse popcorn-like calcifications in the left breast at 4 o'clock.
Focal asymmetry in the left breast at 9 o'clock, middle depth, BI-RADS 3.
Enlarged dense left axillary lymph node measuring 2.0 cm with loss of the fatty hilum, suspicious for metastasis.
Dystrophic calcifications in the left breast upper outer quadrant, at a prior benign biopsy site.

matches.reasoning: A normal right breast statement contradicts the right mastectomy.
The two fibroadenomas include the one at 2 o'clock.
The two fibroadenomas also include the one at 4 o'clock.
One finding at 9 o'clock, read as an oval mass vs a focal asymmetry.
'No left axillary lymphadenopathy' denies the enlarged left axillary node.
